radiopost_vectors: Post office API: requests and answers
rule: Each exchange is one HTTPS request to the post office at its clock `at`, with its path under the base URL, its bearer token and its JSON body, and the answer: status and body. A post office given the same requests in order answers the same, and a gateway or client sends the requests shown. JSON compares as values, not text; a problem's `title` and a result's `text` are for people and need not match. Tokens, session IDs, nonces and cursors are this post office's random or opaque choices: use the ones the answers give. Air forms are those of the session vectors (compression 0).

context.randomness: post office values are stream('post office <what> <n>', bytes)

story.note: Facundo enrolls his tablet with the code the post office gave him.
From his laptop he names his usual gateways, and registers his own, KK4ODA-1.
Mail arrives for facundo@radiopost.org: #419, 'Are you safe?'.
KK4ODA-1 fetches the copies placed ahead for it, and acknowledges them.
Facundo calls N1CALL-10 (session-01.json). The gateway carries his session here.
Transmission 3 brings Facundo's two messages and his receipt for #419.
Transmission 5 brings his receipt for #420; then he hangs up.
KK4ODA-1 polls again. Its token ran out at the end of its hour: the post office answers 401, and the gateway logs in again. The new poll drops the copies of the two messages picked up.

cases.what: session-01, opened 40 s after the client's clock
the post office's clock 601 s after `started`
the same statement twice: a replay
a statement in challenge form: the client's clock was off
a message removed from the statement after signing
carried by a gateway the statement does not name
an enrollment refused twice, then taken with the same code, which is then used
a user's token on a gateway endpoint

messages handed in: accepted; the same again, a duplicate; an air form that is not its message; a message from someone else; a message not in the statement. Then a pickup and a fetch of a serial the session did not list.

results.name: malformed
results.text: the air form is not this message

report.note: N1CALL-10 had no Internet during session-01: it checked Facundo offline (RP-1 §5, §6.3), queued his two messages and served no mail. A day later it reports, with a second, made-up session whose statement no longer matches its signature.
